name: Minimal space
one_line: A few flat planets, thin orbit lines and a lot of quiet.
look_words: Space drawn with very few things. A deep navy background with a sparse scatter of small stars; planets and platforms as flat matte shapes in dusty blue and teal, each with one soft shadow side; thin pale orbit lines. Most of the screen is empty, and that emptiness is the look. Gold marks what to collect, mint the goal, coral-red what to avoid, and the player is a small cream shape. Shapes are circles, rings and simple wedges. Motion is slow and smooth: drifting, orbiting, long curved paths, tiny trails. Avoid nebula clouds, lens flares, realistic textures, crowded star fields, bloom and more than five colours.

palette.name: navy space
palette.notes: Almost no fog in space. One clear light from one side gives every shape its shadow side.

look_wish: flat fills, no outlines, or none

music.mood: slow, soft arpeggio and a warm pad

sound_feel: soft and distant; gentle blips, low whooshes, a chime on pickups
